summary: A future Commercial Mixed Use block on 3rd Street south of Building B, entitled for a 190-ft building over a base with a maximum height of 90 ft on one side and 60 ft on the other with required ground-floor retail. Unbuilt: the Port's June 2026 Phase 2 update describes the site as a surface parking lot, with Phase 2 in pre-development and construction 'as early as 2027'; in 2023 a Port Commission resolution recited that Phase 2 was not currently financially feasible.

milestones.text: Port Commission approves the Mission Rock DDA and Design Controls that set this block's use and envelope (among Resolutions 18-03 to 18-10, which the Jan 30, 2018 minutes record as adopted)

Board of Supervisors affirms the EIR certification and approvals (File No. 171286 per the Notice of Determination; the Port's Oct 2023 report calls No. 33-18 a Resolution and its June 2026 report an Ordinance); Notice of Determination filed March 9, 2018
Development Agreement and DDA take effect; DA term 30 years, project planned in up to four phases

Draft EIR's illustrative phasing (developer's 2015 estimate) placed Block C in Area 2 with Blocks B and D, 2018-2021; later Port reports list a different phasing (the Oct 2023 memo, Table 2, lists Phase 1 as Parcels A, B, F and G)
Developer sends the Port its Phase 2 Submittal (with a Garage Report submitted October 14, 2022 and a Basis of Design November 18, 2022); the budget and appraisal elements are deferred

Port Commission adopts Resolution 23-46 (passed unanimously as amended, with non-substantive changes); its recitals state that Phase 2 is 'not currently financially feasible' and that Port and Developer staff 'mutually agreed earlier this year to decelerate work on Phase 2 while waiting for macroeconomic conditions to improve'

Port staff say later phases 'may require higher percentages of BMR units' to reach the project's 40% target after Phase 1 was cut to 132 BMR units; the Port, developer and MOHCD are reviewing changes 'with the goal of improving the feasibility of future Phases of Mission Rock and accelerating development' (Resolution 25-17)

Port Commission approves Resolution 26-34, authorizing up to $10 million in Port Capital as pre-development funding for Phase 2 (design/engineering for Phase 2 infrastructure and vertical buildings), intended to avoid a 12-18 month delay to construction readiness. Staff's schedule contemplates horizontal infrastructure and vertical building construction beginning as early as Summer/Fall 2027, but the memo's own Table 1 gives illustrative repayment scenarios for a 2027, 2028 or 2029 vertical construction start, contingent on the Developer securing anchor tenants -- not a committed date for this or any other Phase 2 block.

facts.value: Commercial Mixed Use (residential, production, commercial and retail uses permitted; no stand-alone parking garage)

Upper building maximum average floorplate 20,000 sq ft with a 10% reduction on the uppermost two floors; 20-ft building top

open_questions: No architect, program or unit/square-footage figure for Block C exists in any document read; the EIR's project-wide range is 972,000 to 1.4 million gsf of commercial space.

No construction start, Phase 2 budget approval or vertical design submittal for this block was found in Port Commission agendas through February 2026; the block remains part of the Seawall Lot 337 surface parking lot (Lot A).
Which blocks the December 2022 Phase 2 Submittal covers is not stated in the Port memos read; only the Phase 2 parking garage is named.
The DDA 'Outside Dates' for commencing later phases are in the DDA itself, which was not read.
No cost, developer capital or land-value figure exists for this block; the Port says Phase 2 appraisals are deferred until the market supports the minimum land values.

Images: no rendering specific to this block exists in the public-record documents read (the Design Controls give only diagrammatic envelopes), and the 2026 aerial serves as the 'before'/'now' view of the parking lot it sits in.

No expected-completion date could be sourced for Block C. The Mission Rock Design Controls (208 pages, checked in full) contain no phasing schedule at all. The DDA itself (lodged with the Board of Supervisors 2/1/2018, Board File 180092, adopted as Resolution 42-18, effective 8/15/2018) places Parcel C in Phase 2 in its Land Use Table (DDA Section 1.5) and its Exhibit B2 Schedule of Performance gives a 2018 'Target Date' of May 2023 for completing Phase 2's horizontal Phase Improvements -- already elapsed with Phase 2 not begun, and the Outside Date for actual completion is left to a future Phase Schedule that was never approved (Phase 2 was found 'not currently financially feasible' in October 2023, per this record's own milestones). No later Port memo, Design Controls revision or news source gives a revised target year for Phase 2 or for the Project's full buildout, so no basis (record, phase or project) supports a non-elapsed date for this block.

As of 2026-09-21: the June 9, 2026 Port Commission item (Resolution 26-34, $10M pre-development investment) updates the earlier finding below that no Port memo gives a revised target year -- Port staff now have a schedule for Phase 2 pre-development work (through Fall 2027 contractor procurement) and a 'potential' construction start as early as Summer/Fall 2027, but the memo explicitly frames 2027/2028/2029 as alternative scenarios depending on when the Developer secures anchor tenants, not a single committed date -- still no basis (record, phase or project) for an expected-completion milestone for this block specifically.
